title: Link to Windows — connection status
description: Blocks "Your devices are connected." and "Connecting to your PC..." status notifications from Link to Windows. Disconnect alerts, camera-in-use notices, app sharing, and pairing prompts are unaffected. Note: these are ongoing notifications and may stay in the shade on older Android versions.

rules.titleFilter: (?i)^(your devices are connected\.?|connecting to your pc(\.{3}|…)?)\s*$
